title: Potato and mushroom gratin with sun-dried tomatoes
blurb: Layers of sliced potato and mushrooms baked in a creamy garlic sauce with sun-dried tomatoes.
steps: Heat your oven to 180°C. Peel the potatoes and slice them thinly, about 3mm thick, then slice the mushrooms and finely slice the onion.
Crush the garlic cloves and chop the sun-dried tomatoes into strips. Butter a medium baking dish.
Mix the cream and milk together in a jug with the garlic and some salt and pepper.
Layer half the potato slices in the dish, then add the mushrooms, onion and sun-dried tomatoes in an even layer.
Top with the remaining potato slices, arranging them neatly, then pour the cream mixture over the top.
Grate the cheddar over the surface and cover the dish tightly with foil.
Bake for 25 minutes, then remove the foil and bake for another 5 minutes until the top is golden and the potatoes are tender when pierced with a knife.
